queries.name: InfrastructureExplorerQuery
rules: contextual tree is a projection only; it does not imply that containment equals Rack hierarchy or Cloud hierarchy
each collection paginates independently and never materializes full installation

queries.name: NetworkElementDetailQuery
rules: IP/placement/Cloud/containment displayed as independent sections
no connectivity/reachability/SSH projection exists

queries.name: InfrastructureHistoryQuery
output: ordered domain events/relationship corrections with recorded/effective chronology when applicable
rules: history joins only bounded allowlisted display fields
corrections do not hide original events
source workbook bodies/secrets are never rendered

queries.name: SiteDetailQuery
output: dedicated Dispatch Location identity/current derived address
rules: Dispatch Location remains distinct identity
archive blockers are read-only detail and writer still revalidates guards

queries.name: RackOccupancyQuery
output: ordered current U intervals with Network Element identity/name
conflict flag if corrupted legacy data detected
rules: derived from network_element_placement_current
no containment/topology inference

queries.name: NetworkElementCandidateQuery
rules: no score threshold authorizes identity
candidate result is review evidence only

queries.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionQuery
output: current Network Element resolution or none
related operational Device Reference context without retargeting it
rules: terminal Ticket history remains ordinary operational history
resolution is Infrastructure relationship only

queries.name: ModelDetailQuery
rules: installed component instances are not included as compatibility truth; they are queried per Network Element

queries.name: InstalledComponentQuery
output: Device Part Unit resolution if any
rules: maintenance consequence is display provenance, not Infrastructure-owned Task outcome
removed components remain historically queryable

queries.name: IpCandidateQuery
output: Network Elements currently carrying same canonical address
rules: cross-element duplicate is informational matching evidence only
never emits topology/reachability claims

queries.name: SiteArchiveBlockerQuery
output: bounded typed blockers from physical and registered cross-domain validators
rules: read-only enumeration outside writer lock
INDETERMINATE source is displayed and fails authoritative archive closed

reader_contract: All list/detail/history queries use stable LLD-01 snapshots, explicit bounds and deterministic cursors. No read query mutates projections or promotes candidates.
